statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative audit of four MediaWiki templates/flows. Excluded authenticated editing/account flows and page archetypes sharing the same Vector/MediaWiki shell.

page.notes: Server-rendered Portuguese encyclopedia. Article, category, portal and empty-search templates sampled.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is visually identical to the light screenshot, and computed styles report color-scheme: normal with a light body surface.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated reduced motion screenshot and live animation probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Reduced-motion capture plus getAnimations() found no active animation or auto-advance.
High-contrast preference capture retained visible text and controls.
The live CSS probe found no view-transition usage although the browser supports it.

checkOutcomes.reason: No scroll-linked visual motion exists on the representative templates, so there is no implementation to move off-thread.
The reading, category and search templates expose no custom swipe, pull, carousel or snap gesture.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After scrolling 1200px, the table of contents remained at y=72 while the article header moved offscreen.
The live CSS probe found no anchor-name or position-anchor rules on an interface with multiple menus.

checkOutcomes.method: Cross-template screenshot review and scroll probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Screenshots show active page tabs, selected appearance controls, section hierarchy and persistent table of contents cues.
No load-time overlay or interstitial obscured any of the four representative pages.
The live semantic probe found 0 dialog, 0 popover, and 0 details elements despite menu/disclosure controls in the page chrome.
Article and category desktop screenshots prioritize content, with slim global chrome and no advertising.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct review of evidence/home-mobile.png, evidence/article-mobile.png, evidence/category-mobile.png, evidence/home-layout-mobile.json, evidence/article-layout-mobile.json.
checkOutcomes.evidence: At requested viewport 360x800, every layout capture reports innerWidth/clientWidth 1120 and meta viewport width=1120; mobile screenshots show unreadably small text and controls.
The live CSS probe found no @container usage across the article interface.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct review of evidence/probe.json, evidence/lighthouse.json, evidence/article-mobile.png.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The live probe counted 2,829 rendered targets below 24px in at least one dimension; Lighthouse target-size failed. Keyboard focus was visible.
Homepage, article, category and search screenshots have explicit headings and clear read/search/navigation actions.
Article reading, category navigation and search submission all completed without an account wall or dead end.

checkOutcomes.method: No-result search screenshot and DOM inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The no-results search clearly states that no result was produced and preserves the query with controls to retry or refine.
Lighthouse measured LCP 5.6s (score 0.18), despite a warm desktop trace measuring 808ms, indicating a material mobile/cold-load problem.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout-shift observers on all representative templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Layout observer measured CLS 0.00023 on the article and 0 on the other templates.

checkOutcomes.method: DevTools trace summary and layout long-task observer.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Trace measured one 118.56ms task and 68.56ms TBT, with no sustained long-task pattern.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct review of evidence/article-summary.json, evidence/article.har, evidence/lighthouse.json.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HAR captured 130 requests and 3,193,306 transferred bytes, including 116 images/2,575,721 bytes; Lighthouse reports 177KiB cache and 150ms render-blocking savings.
Lighthouse estimates 49KiB unused CSS and 86KiB unused JavaScript.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct review of evidence/lighthouse.json, evidence/images.json, evidence/probe.json.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse failed image-alt and label; the live probe found one unlabelled form control, and the image audit reported many null alt values.
Lighthouse failed link-in-text-block, showing that links in body text are not distinguishable without color.
Lighthouse failed table-fake-caption and agent-accessibility-tree. The page otherwise has one main landmark and visible focused-link outline.
At 360px the forced 1120px layout renders body text at roughly one-third scale, materially harming reading comfort.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct review of evidence/article-mobile.png, evidence/probe.json, evidence/lighthouse.json.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The viewport probe returns width=1120 and Lighthouse target-size fails; 360px screenshots render a scaled-down desktop canvas.
Lighthouse console-errors audit passed with zero logged errors.
Image primitive reports 2 missing-dimension images and Lighthouse unsized-images fails; Lighthouse estimates 96KiB image-delivery savings.
Lighthouse failed inspector-issues and valid-source-maps, while deprecations, BFCache, permission-on-load and paste checks passed.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct review of evidence/probe.json, evidence/article-discoverability.json, evidence/lighthouse.json.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The live probe and discoverability primitive found a descriptive title but no meta description; Lighthouse meta-description failed.

checkOutcomes.method: Live metadata/link probe plus Lighthouse SEO.
checkOutcomes.evidence: All 4,269 anchors have hrefs and robots allows indexing, but the viewport is fixed to width=1120 rather than mobile-friendly.

checkOutcomes.method: Discoverability fetch, live metadata probe and Lighthouse SEO.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Article returned HTTP 200, canonical matched, robots allowed indexing and Lighthouse canonical/robots/hreflang audits passed.
The article exposes one JSON-LD block and five Open Graph fields aligned to visible article content.
Headers show CSP with unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval. Cookie evidence shows six Secure cookies all marked SameSite=None.
Tracker scan found no known trackers or analytics domains; third-party origins were Wikimedia infrastructure and no secrets were exposed.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse permission audits and path walkthrough.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse confirms no notification or geolocation prompt on load; the audited public reading/search flows require no authentication.
Header evidence finds no frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy, while HSTS and nosniff are present.
Raw server HTML contains 100% of rendered content words and retains title and h1 without JavaScript.

checkOutcomes.method: Interaction walkthrough, scroll probe and Lighthouse console audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Search, navigation and sticky table-of-contents behavior remained coherent in exercised states with no console errors.

checkOutcomes.reason: Wikipedia is a public content MPA rather than an installable app; offline installation is not required for the audited reading journey.

checkOutcomes.method: No-result search state plus discoverability evidence.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The search empty state provides an explicit message, retained query and retry/refinement controls; server-rendered pages avoid a blank client shell.
The Portuguese article declares html lang=pt and dir=ltr and renders localized navigation/content.
Portuguese labels, numeric separators and article date presentation are localized consistently on sampled templates.

checkOutcomes.reason: The representative encyclopedia reading, category and search paths do not schedule events or expose user-sensitive time-zone calculations.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No ads, consent wall, confirmshaming, forced continuity or disguised controls appeared on any sampled path.
The no-results search uses neutral language, preserves the query, and offers advanced-search refinement rather than blaming the user.

checkOutcomes.method: Live form probe and submitted search state.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The only user-entered field in scope is search; it has type=search, an accessible search interface and retained query state.

checkOutcomes.reason: No checkout, subscription, payment, consent, or account-management flow is part of the audited public encyclopedia journey.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Images evidence reports 80 below-fold images without lazy loading and 98 legacy-format derivatives; HAR attributes 2.58MB to images.
Trace showed only one bounded long task and tracker scan found no analytics/background beacon churn.
The HAR transfers 3.19MB, of which 2.54MB is from upload.wikimedia.org, before the reader scrolls through the long article.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct review of evidence/article-discoverability.json, evidence/lighthouse.json, evidence/probe.json.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Discoverability reports 100% raw-HTML coverage and JSON-LD exists, but Lighthouse agent-accessibility-tree fails and no structured agent tool interface was detected.

checkOutcomes.reason: Server-rendered reference content does not need on-device generation or summarization to complete its core reading/search tasks.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten menu toggles the snapshot delta was +1,427 nodes (+0.36%) and +2.09MB; no unbounded trend or Detached constructor appeared in the retained summary.
Post-interaction heap summary contains 395,360 nodes and 30,547,712 self-size bytes. Ten menu toggles changed totals by +1,427 nodes and +2,087,663 bytes, without a clear Detached constructor signal.
Neither baseline nor post summary exposed a Detached constructor among retained top constructors after ten toggles.

paths.description: Portuguese Wikipedia landing page, representing portal navigation and featured-content discovery.
Portugal article, representing the primary long-form reading journey and MediaWiki article template.
No-results search, representing search form submission, empty state and recovery.

findings.summary: The interface does not follow the system dark-color preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is visually identical to the light screenshot, and computed styles report color-scheme: normal with a light body surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply color-scheme: light dark and preference-driven surface/text tokens, while retaining the existing explicit appearance control.

findings.summary: Page navigations and state changes swap without View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The live CSS probe found no view-transition usage although the browser supports it.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance eligible article and route navigations with same-document or cross-document View Transitions and a non-animated fallback.

findings.summary: Menus and transient controls do not use CSS anchor positioning.
findings.evidence: The live CSS probe found no anchor-name or position-anchor rules on an interface with multiple menus.
findings.suggestedFix: Use CSS anchor positioning and position-try fallbacks for menus/tooltips where edge-aware attachment is needed.

findings.summary: Transient/disclosure UI is not built with modern semantic overlay primitives.
findings.evidence: The live semantic probe found 0 dialog, 0 popover, and 0 details elements despite menu/disclosure controls in the page chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Migrate transient menus to popover and suitable disclosures to details, preserving accessible fallback behavior.

findings.summary: The site forces a 1120 CSS-pixel viewport on phones, producing a tiny scaled desktop layout.
findings.evidence: At requested viewport 360x800, every layout capture reports innerWidth/clientWidth 1120 and meta viewport width=1120; mobile screenshots show unreadably small text and controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width, initial-scale=1 and responsive layout rules so article, category, search and portal templates reflow at the device width.

findings.summary: Components do not use container-level adaptation.
findings.evidence: The live CSS probe found no @container usage across the article interface.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container queries to reusable navigation, infobox, search and content modules that appear in differently sized regions.

findings.summary: Thousands of links and controls are too small for reliable touch input.
findings.evidence: The live probe counted 2,829 rendered targets below 24px in at least one dimension; Lighthouse target-size failed. Keyboard focus was visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target boxes and spacing for dense links and controls, especially at narrow widths, while retaining visible :focus-visible styles.

findings.summary: Mobile Largest Contentful Paint is slow.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 5.6s (score 0.18), despite a warm desktop trace measuring 808ms, indicating a material mobile/cold-load problem.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the LCP request chain, prioritize the LCP resource, and reduce render-blocking and eager below-fold work.

findings.summary: The article loads a large eager image set and avoidable blocking/cache cost.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 130 requests and 3,193,306 transferred bytes, including 116 images/2,575,721 bytes; Lighthouse reports 177KiB cache and 150ms render-blocking savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold media, tighten cache lifetimes where possible, and reduce the confirmed critical CSS chain.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable unused CSS and JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 49KiB unused CSS and 86KiB unused JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Split ResourceLoader modules by page capability and defer optional editing/gadget code until requested.

findings.summary: Images and a form control lack accessible alternatives or labels.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed image-alt and label; the live probe found one unlabelled form control, and the image audit reported many null alt values.
findings.suggestedFix: Give informative images concise alt text, decorative images alt="", and every control a programmatic label.

findings.summary: Inline links rely on color alone.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed link-in-text-block, showing that links in body text are not distinguishable without color.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a non-color cue such as a persistent underline with an accessible underline treatment.

findings.summary: Parts of the accessibility structure are malformed.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed table-fake-caption and agent-accessibility-tree. The page otherwise has one main landmark and visible focused-link outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real table captions and repair the nodes identified in the accessibility tree while preserving the sound landmark and focus behavior.

findings.summary: The fixed 1120px viewport prevents normal mobile reflow and leaves targets undersized.
findings.evidence: The viewport probe returns width=1120 and Lighthouse target-size fails; 360px screenshots render a scaled-down desktop canvas.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore a device-width scalable viewport and redesign dense navigation/infobox content to reflow with sufficiently spaced targets.

findings.summary: Some images omit intrinsic dimensions and image delivery is inefficient.
findings.evidence: Image primitive reports 2 missing-dimension images and Lighthouse unsized-images fails; Lighthouse estimates 96KiB image-delivery savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width and height for every image and select appropriately sized responsive derivatives.

findings.summary: DevTools reports unresolved inspector and source-map hygiene issues.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed inspector-issues and valid-source-maps, while deprecations, BFCache, permission-on-load and paste checks passed.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve the reported browser issue and publish valid production source maps, or intentionally suppress map references.

findings.summary: Public article pages omit a meta description.
findings.evidence: The live probe and discoverability primitive found a descriptive title but no meta description; Lighthouse meta-description failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate an accurate article-specific meta description from the lead, with sensible length and escaping.

findings.summary: The CSP permits unsafe script/style execution and cookies use SameSite=None broadly.
findings.evidence: Headers show CSP with unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval. Cookie evidence shows six Secure cookies all marked SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unsafe-eval/unsafe-inline through nonces or hashes where feasible and narrow cookie SameSite attributes to the actual cross-site requirement.

findings.summary: Several defensive browser policies are absent.
findings.evidence: Header evidence finds no frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy, while HSTS and nosniff are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Set frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy; consider Trusted Types for high-risk script surfaces.

findings.summary: The article eagerly requests many legacy-format, below-fold images.
findings.evidence: Images evidence reports 80 below-fold images without lazy loading and 98 legacy-format derivatives; HAR attributes 2.58MB to images.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold images and negotiate efficient modern formats while preserving Wikimedia responsive derivatives and compatibility.

findings.summary: Resource use is disproportionate for an initial text-article view.
findings.evidence: The HAR transfers 3.19MB, of which 2.54MB is from upload.wikimedia.org, before the reader scrolls through the long article.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer below-fold Commons media and keep only above-the-fold, user-valued assets on the initial critical path.

findings.summary: Machine-readable content is strong, but interactive semantics are not fully agent-ready.
findings.evidence: Discoverability reports 100% raw-HTML coverage and JSON-LD exists, but Lighthouse agent-accessibility-tree fails and no structured agent tool interface was detected.
findings.suggestedFix: First repair the accessibility tree; then evaluate narrowly scoped, safe structured tools for search or citation retrieval rather than requiring agents to infer UI actions.

findings.summary: The memory footprint is heavy for a mostly static article.
findings.evidence: Post-interaction heap summary contains 395,360 nodes and 30,547,712 self-size bytes. Ten menu toggles changed totals by +1,427 nodes and +2,087,663 bytes, without a clear Detached constructor signal.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce eagerly constructed article/UI nodes and optional modules; repeat same-session heap testing to distinguish one-time warm-up from retained growth.
